title: samurai gallery case
description: Metadata contract for a single gallery case. One case = one directory under cases/. This file is the single source of truth: the website and the media pipeline are generated from it.

title.description: Human-readable case title shown on the card and case page.

summary.description: One-sentence description shown on the gallery card.

authors.description: Names (and optionally emails) of the case authors.

methods.description: Numerical method families exercised by this case. Drives the site filter.

equation.description: Slug identifying the governing equation, e.g. 'compressible-euler', 'linear-advection', 'navier-stokes-incompressible', 'reaction-diffusion'.

featured.description: Highlight this case on the landing page hero.

requires.description: Optional samurai build features this case needs. CI skips the case if a feature is unavailable.

env.description: conda/micromamba environment used to build and run this case (default: samurai-gallery). Media post-processing always runs in samurai-gallery.

engine.description: For cases powered by an external solver (e.g. samurai-euler) instead of a local main.cpp. When present, main.cpp is not required; the case builds the target from an external CMake project and displays 'code_file' on the site.

source.description: Path to the external CMake project, relative to the gallery root (e.g. ../samurai-euler). Overridable in CI via $GALLERY_ENGINE_<NAME>.

code_file.description: Path (relative to the case dir) of the source file shown on the site as this case's code. Typically a copy of the scenario header.

references.description: External references (papers, competitor test pages, docs).

media.description: Media file names produced by postprocess.py (relative to the case dir). Generated in CI, never committed.

run.description: How to build and run the case.

target.description: CMake target name (defined in the case CMakeLists.txt, or in the engine project for engine-based cases).

output_prefix.description: Prefix of the .h5/.xdmf files the simulation writes, without the per-iteration suffix.

output_subdir.description: Subdirectory (relative to the run directory) the executable writes its output into. Default: none. samurai-euler writes into 'results'.

profiles.description: Run profiles. 'ci' is a fast run used to generate lightweight preview media; 'hero' is an optional high-resolution run.

args.description: CLI arguments passed to the simulation executable.

nfiles.description: Number of output frames the run produces (used by postprocess.py to build the animation).
